title: Payroll employment increases by 162,000 in August; unemployment rate unchanged at 4.1%
author: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
summary: Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 162,000 in August, and the unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1 percent. Employment increased in food services and drinking places and in local government education.…
bodyHtml: Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 162,000 in August, and the unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1 percent. Employment increased in food services and drinking places and in local government education. The information industry lost jobs.
